proof.gate.promoted_subsystems.s.why: The formal phase's proof run (verify-promoted-subsystems.sh full) on a default Boat VM after untimed tool bootstraps; solver and Lean times vary with VM load, and Rust builds inside the gate start cold.

sim.dst.serial_total_s.why: The D79 simulator set (sim.dst.serial_total_s), run serially on a Boat default VM. #1223 saw 33.4 s and 34.7 s for the same set on two VMs (about 4%); 15% leaves room for VM-to-VM CPU variance on a single run.
